scenes.say: Do oncoming headlights blind you at night? Watch for these three signs.

scenes.en: In the dark, your pupil opens wide. Haze scatters the light into glare.
scenes.say: In the dark, your pupil opens wide. Any haze in the eye, or smudges on your glasses, scatter the light into glare.

scenes.en: Rings or rays around every light.
scenes.say: Sign one. Rings or rays around every streetlight.

scenes.en: Your sight takes longer to clear after a bright light.
scenes.say: Sign two. After a bright light passes, your sight takes longer to clear.

scenes.en: The eye's lens can slowly turn cloudy. Night glare is an early sign of cataract.
scenes.ta: கண் லென்ஸ் மங்கலாகலாம் – கண்புரையின் ஆரம்ப அறிகுறி
scenes.say: Sign three. It gets worse every year. The lens inside the eye can slowly turn cloudy, and night glare is a common early sign of cataract.

scenes.en: Clean the windscreen inside and out. Keep glasses spotless. Look at the left edge of the road.
scenes.ta: கண்ணாடியைச் சுத்தமாக வையுங்கள், சாலையின் இடது ஓரத்தைப் பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: Clean your windscreen inside and out. Keep your glasses spotless, and look at the left edge of the road, not into the lights.

scenes.en: Yellow 'night driving' glasses don't help. Anti-reflective coated lenses cut reflections.
scenes.say: Did you know? Yellow night driving glasses don't help, and can make you see less. Lenses with anti-reflective coating cut reflections.

scenes.en: Sudden blur or vision loss? See an eye specialist urgently. Book an eye test today.
scenes.ta: திடீர் மங்கலா? உடனே கண் மருத்துவரைப் பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: If your vision drops suddenly, see an eye specialist the same day. Otherwise, book an eye test before your next night drive.
